entries.content: Feature: academia-botao-voltar. Decisions: Add a top back link on /admin/academias/[id]/editar pointing to /academias, replicating the existing detail page pattern (next/link + ArrowLeft from lucide-react + muted text classes). Rename the bottom form Cancelar button to Descartar alterações for semantic clarity. Constraints: Keep changes inside a single page file; reuse existing shadcn/ui Button; do not introduce new shared components.

Feature: academia-botao-voltar. Objective: Add a back button to the gym edit screen so users can return to the gym list without submitting the form. Scope: render Voltar para a busca link above the page title; rename Cancelar to Descartar alterações; update page.test.tsx assertions. Out-of-scope: changing form validation, navigation behavior of the bottom button, creating new shared components, altering the detail page.
